digest: Kluczowe dziś: Bitcoin hovers near $75k after liquidations, with BTC 24h volatility elevated and a fresh wave of wash-trading memecoins from the Binance hack — noise that can masquerade as momentum. Fear & Greed sits in Fear (32/29/28/25/28/50/34), so the market is fragile and mean-reverting. News is lagging and event-driven (tariff truce, Nvidia leadership scare, Fed expectations), which raises the risk of chasing headlines that already priced in the move. The bot's losses cluster on negative short-term momentum, rising volatility and negative BTC correlation — the exact regime we should filter out.

ideas.name: Odrzuć sygnały w rosnącej zmienności i spadkowym Bitcoinie
ideas.why: This rule removes the bot's most consistent losing pattern: short-term momentum, rising volatility and a negative BTC correlation. It keeps only signals where the short-term volatility is not expanding, momentum is positive and Bitcoin is not in a sharp downtrend.

ideas.name: Wymuś potwierdzenie przez Bitcoin, relację 7 dni i wolumen
ideas.why: This rule requires the coin to be in the top 60% of 24h momentum, to be outperforming Bitcoin over 7 days, and to have volume above the 24h average. It removes the pattern of chasing weak, low-volume coins that are falling with Bitcoin.

ideas.name: Odrzuć sygnały z nadmiernie rozciągniętych i wyczerpanych trendów
